Name: JP's Menu Scroll Speed
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ff00][size=6][u][center]Menu Scroll Speed[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]
[color=#9900ff][size=5][b][i]After 10 minutes of moving across this large map from one end to the other, I discovered that... This wasn't the building I wanted to place![/i][/b][/size][/color]


[size=4][b]The function of this mod is to increase the speed at which the screen scrolls in these animal and building placement menus. It is very useful on very large maps or simply if you don't like it going so slowly on your little farm.

[color=#00ffff]Simple, straightforward and with immediate effect, several speed options available.[/color] [/b][/size]


[youtube]9vcbKYVMgsA[/youtube]

[color=#00ff00][size=5][i][b]That's it. Using GMCM, you'll find descriptions of each configuration so you can see what they contain and make your choices. Enjoy trying out different speeds, but be aware that very high speeds may cause headaches. [/b][/i][/size][/color]


[b][i][color=#ffff00][size=6][u]Translations[/u][/size][/color][/i]
[/b][size=4][b]You are free to translate the mod; [color=#ff0000]you don't need to ask my permission[/color].
You can publish it yourself on Nexusmods or send it to me to integrate it, it's up to you.
If you like, you can also let me know that your translation has been published, so I know you're out there.
[/b]
